insurer: The New India Assurance Co. Ltd.
plan_name: New India Sixty Plus Mediclaim Policy

room_rent.note: Room rent capped at 1% of Sum Insured per day; ICU at 2% of SI per day. Room rent sub-limit capped at 25% of SI+Bonus per illness.

icu.note: ICU charges capped at 2% of Sum Insured per day, included within 25% of SI+Bonus per illness limit.

copayment.note: 10% co-pay applies on all admissible claims. Not applicable for claims under section 3.2 (specified surgeries). Optional voluntary extra 10% co-pay available for premium discount.

sub_limits.display: Many sub-limits: cataract, CABG, joint replacement, cancer, etc.
sub_limits.note: Section 3.2 caps: cataract ₹15k–₹25k, CABG ₹1.5L–₹2.75L, joint replacement ₹80k–₹1.5L, major cancer surgery ₹1.4L–₹2.75L, PTCA ₹75k–₹1.5L, organ transplant ₹1.5L–₹3L, and many more. Modern treatments also sub-limited (3.14). Section 3.1 sub-limits: room 25%, surgeon fees 25%, consumables/medicines 50% of SI+Bonus per illness.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 36 months of continuous coverage. No reduction option mentioned.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 90-day wait: diabetes, hypertension, cardiac conditions. 24-month wait: cataract, hernia, piles, fissure, fistula, hydrocele, stones, etc. 36-month wait: joint replacement (degenerative), ARMD, mental illness, genetic disorders, congenital external diseases.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded under standard exclusion Excl18.

cumulative_bonus.display: Cumulative Bonus Buffer carried forward only
cumulative_bonus.note: No fresh accrual of cumulative bonus under this policy. Only existing Cumulative Bonus Buffer from prior policies is protected and carried forward. No new no-claim bonus accrues.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days, subject to max 10% of SI combined with post-hospitalisation.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days, subject to max 10% of SI combined with pre-hospitalisation.

day_care.note: Day care covered for procedures listed in Annexure I; not all day-care procedures.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation is explicitly excluded under section 4.4.17.

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to 100% of Sum Insured per policy year.

organ_donor.note: Donor hospitalisation expenses covered under section 3.11, but limited to the major organ transplant sub-limit in section 3.2 (₹1.5L–₹3L). Cost of organ itself excluded.

ambulance.note: Ambulance charges covered up to 1% of Sum Insured per hospitalisation for emergency admission or inter-hospital transfer.

modern_treatments.note: Modern treatments covered under section 3.14 with individual sub-limits: robotic surgery up to 10% of SI (max ₹50k), oral chemotherapy up to 50% of SI (max ₹2.5L), intravitreal injections up to 25% of SI (max ₹1L), etc.

consumables.note: Consumables like gloves, masks, etc. are listed in Annexure II List I as non-payable items. Surgical consumables/disposables in section 3.1.3 are covered only as part of hospitalisation up to 50% of SI sub-limit.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment only within India (section 5.11). Treatment outside India is excluded (section 4.4.28).

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium mode and 30 days for all other modes. Coverage not available during grace period.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document for new policies of 1 year or more.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers allowed as per IRDAI guidelines.

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary hospitalisation, treatment outside India, sleep apnoea, RFQMR/ECP/EECP/hyperbaric oxygen, acupressure/acupuncture, dental (unless accident), vaccination, venereal disease, suicide attempt injuries

optional_riders.display: Voluntary extra 10% co-pay (total 20%) for premium discount
